name: National Bank of Kuwait - Egypt
source: National Bank of Kuwait - Egypt (S.A.E), Auditors report and financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025 (audited, translation of statements originally issued in Arabic), EGP thousand, stored absolute
source_note: Read from the audited FY2025 statement of financial position, EGP thousand stored absolute. Total Liabilities 194,695,343 + Total Equity 30,164,991 = Total Assets 224,860,334, exactly. Cash and Equivalents is the closing figure the bank states in its own cash flow statement (cash and due from Central Bank plus due from banks plus treasury bills, less balances under the mandatory reserve and treasury bills with more than three months to maturity); it is not the 19,951,373 balance sheet line, which excludes the treasury bill holdings.
